title: Ritual: omen favours
summary: Run Ritual tablets that tilt favours toward Omens and make deferring cheaper, then buy the omens with tribute. Since 0.5.5 a second Ritual Tablet adds an extra altar.

budget.why: Two magic Ritual Tablets and waystones rolled for pack size only.
budget.build_needs: Kills revived Ritual waves; no boss requirement.

complexity.why: At every altar, reroll the favours for Omens and defer the ones you cannot afford yet — a choice loop in the map.

yields.why: Listed among Ritual items (favours); 'of Omens' raises the chance a favour is an Omen.

waystone.notes: Every monster slain in the circle feeds the altar, and pack size adds monsters plus a chance of an extra rare to each pack.

claim.note: poe2db Ritual: 'Every monster you slaughter in the circle will feed the altar.' 0.5.0: pack size modifiers add a chance for an additional Rare Monster. More tribute from more monsters is our reading, not measured; no source says rarer monsters grant more tribute, so monster rarity is left out.

steps: Allocate Mysterious Rites and Patient Devotion, then Tempting Offers and the Increased Tribute nodes.
Set Hilda: Ancient Inscriptions; T1, T2 and T4 are free picks.
Slot two Ritual Tablets (0.5.5: more than one adds an extra altar if possible); each takes one suffix, 'of Omens' first.
Reroll for Omens; defer the ones you cannot afford yet and buy them when they return.
Forbidden Rites: Ritual can reward Sacred Blooms, which add the Viridian Wildwood to a cluster of maps; Wisps collected there make that map's monsters more powerful and rewarding (0.5.5).
risks: Royal Lenience defers with tribute already offered to the King at 500% more cost — it trades away Audience progress.
Which Omens a favour list offers is random; the basket prices examples only.
Sacred Blooms drop only in the Forbidden Rites league; 0.5.5 disabled the Viridian Wildwood unique map.
